title: Topological Sort
description: Write a Zig program that performs topological sorting on a directed acyclic graph.
hints: Kahn's algorithm: start with nodes that have in-degree 0
Reduce in-degree of neighbors when a node is processed
When a neighbor's in-degree becomes 0, add it to the queue
Uses `@intCast()` to convert between usize and u8
